text:
Ravi: Opening a compact PR to add a small 'dashboard preset + trace headers' migration note and a Go SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13021 :eyes:
Elena: thanks. can you keep the Go example to 3-4 lines? we don't need a full client. just show header + minimal request.
Ravi: planned snippet:```go
// attach trace id header in Go net/http
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("x-rw-trace-id", traceID)
client.Do(req)
```
June: looks good. add comment showing where to pick cost header (we emit `x-rw-cost-usd` on responses). otherwise people will wonder where cost data comes from.
Ravi: added a small reply in the PR noting response header. also added a one-liner about batching: "Note: server-side batching can change observed per-token latency; compare token counts, not absolute ms, for cost attribution."
ben-docs: CI flagged a broken anchor in the migration doc: `#dashboard-presets` changed to `#dashboard-presets-usage`. link-check fails on files/docs/observability/migration.md line 42.
ci-bot: :warning: link-check failed for files/docs/observability/migration.md line 42 -> https://docs.redwood.inference/observability/migration.md#dashboard-presets (status 404). Job: https://ci.redwood-inference/pipeline/7321
Elena: easy fix, Ravi can update the internal anchor in the PR comment or we update the target link to `#dashboard-presets-usage`.
Ravi: updated the PR to point to the new anchor and pushed. also compressed the new screenshot (was 2.4MB) to 180KB.
June: small nit: the Go snippet uses `traceID` but nowhere do we show how to generate it. can we add a parenthetical: `(e.g., uuid.New().String())`?
Ravi: added that inline.
ben-docs: please also add a tiny changelog note under "Docs updates" so release notes include the header names. QA-Teresa will use that to test.
QA-Teresa: i'll add a quick regression test: request with `x-rw-trace-id` + simulated response header `x-rw-cost-usd` and assert dashboard ingestion via test harness. will push test as a follow-up.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: link-check passed for files/docs/observability/migration.md (job 7324).
Elena: linter caught a triple space in a fenced code block. ran `make docs-lint` locally and fixed.
ben-docs: merged after squash, kept commits tidy.
deploy-bot: deploy started for branch docs/trace-and-presets (build 244).
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded  site updated at https://docs.redwood.inference/observability/migration.html
Ravi: thanks all :raised_hands: i'll follow up with a tiny preset JSON example in another PR (very small). QA-Teresa: regression test in progress, i'll post results here once it runs.
